name: openjutsu
description: fakinflu RunPod serverless worker: Openjutsu (SydFloyd/openjutsu, open source Genjutsu clone) on ComfyUI. Image Dockerfile: recast + replace (Wan 2.2 Animate 14B int8, DWPose) and SAM 2.1 click masks. Inputs: normalized clip (16 fps, 480x832 or 832x480), reference image, mask. Outputs: mask.mkv, result.mp4.

endpoint.name: fakinflu-openjutsu-worker
endpoint.notes: Reglages reels de l'endpoint (console, 2026-10-22) : ADA_48_PRO en excluant L40, L40S et RTX 6000 Ada, soit PRO 6000 MIG 48GB (1,75 $/h serverless, catalogue RunPod 2026-10-22). Timeout 600 s : un job (sonde, masque, generation) doit tenir en 10 min, les clips entiers demandent plus. Image ~32 Go (unet Wan2.2-Animate-14B int8 ~18 Go + encodeurs ~8 Go + LoRA relight et lightx2v ~2,2 Go + DWPose + SAM 2.1). COMFY_EXTRA_ARGS modifiable sans rebuild.
